description:
FILED s543 by the reviewing session (2026-11-22, evening), review probe b-13 of s543h's CODE MOVED change 9b024238 (~/pcl-agent-scratch/s543/review/probes-1122/rh2, rh3).  Not a regression: main b58114ca is wrong on the same program with another face.

REPRODUCER (perl 5.40 | main b58114ca | s543h 9b024238):
    our $v = "mainv"; $Bar::v = "barv";
    print eval('package Bar; my @o; for (1..2) { local ${v} = "loc$_"; push @o, ${v} } join(",", @o) . " " . ${v}'), " $v\n";
    # perl:  loc1,loc2 mainv mainv
    # main:  loc1,loc2 barv mainv        (the read after the loop is $Bar::v)
    # s543h: mainv,mainv mainv mainv     (the reads are right; the `local` hits another variable)

WHAT NARROWS IT (all = perl on s543h's tree): the plain spelling `local $v` in the same eval (c-01); the brace spelling outside an eval, `package Bar; ... local ${v}` (c-02); the eval without the `package` (c-03); the eval + package with NO `our` at the site (c-05, c-06).  So: the eval site's `our` alias (s543h's `our:` site input) reaches the READ of a brace-spelled name and not the `local` statement's target for the same spelling.

FIX DIRECTION: one resolver (CLAUDE.md "A detector, its rewriter and its promoter share ONE resolver"): the `local` plan's target (`_local_var_cl` and the plan s543g wrote) must take a brace-spelled name through the same site-input lookup as `_rewrite_var_uses` / `_brace_name_refs`.  Probe the three sigils and an element (`local ${h}{k}` is #5372 -- it dies before it gets here).


=== DONE (s543l) ===
Fixed with #5372 (see there): a brace-spelled `local` target is the plain spelling's token before any plan reads it
(Pl::Stmt::brace_names_plain over Parser2::brace_name_of), so `local ${v}` in eval text behind `package Bar;` at a
site with `our $v` lowers to `(p-local-cell $v ...)` -- the variable `${v}` reads -- where it was the symbolic
`(p-local-deref-scalar "v")`, Bar's.  No change inside _rewrite_var_uses or the Binder was needed (the plain `local
$v` was already right, c-01).  The reproducer, c-10 and the narrowing rows = perl (scratch/s543l/probes/m1 a16-a22);
the whole-hash and whole-array faces (`local %{h}`, `local @{a}`, wrong on the base too) as well.  Guard
eval-capture-01.t blocal_* (4 rows, all failing on the base).


FINAL SHA (s543l, 2026-11-27): the batch is MERGE-READY at 2f85209e, rebased onto main 4b0d5d50 (its code = s543m final 5d426786 + this batch; the review fix L1 for #5333 is 6a1301ed); the notes above cite pre-rebase shas.
